questions.q: REPLACE_ME How far ahead should I book?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Two to three weeks for a weekday, longer for weekends in summer.
REPLACE_ME We move the date, at no charge, as long as we decide by midday on the day.

questions.q: REPLACE_ME How long does a shoot take?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Two hours for The drive, about three for The evening. A dealer day is a full day.

questions.q: REPLACE_ME Do I need to clean the car first?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Yes, and the cleaner the better: paint shows everything in low light.

questions.q: REPLACE_ME Can you hide my number plate?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Yes. We blur it in every photograph and film. Just say when you book.

questions.q: REPLACE_ME Do you fly a drone?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Only where the rules and the place allow it, and only in calm weather, so we never promise it.

questions.q: REPLACE_ME Can I post the film with music?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Yes. We use licensed music, cleared for social media.

questions.q: REPLACE_ME Can our dealership use the work in ads?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Tell us where it will run and we'll include that use in the quote.

questions.q: REPLACE_ME How soon do I get it?
questions.a: REPLACE_ME Photographs in five working days, films in ten. Pick a date on the packages page to see yours.
